subject.title: Explore deterministic profiling gates for Crabbox runs

question: Should Crabbox sponsor a built-in deterministic fuel gate, and if so must its first metered WASM runtime run out of process rather than inside the Crabbox process?
rationale: Source inspection can establish the implementation gap, but it cannot choose whether Crabbox should accept and maintain a new untrusted-code runtime boundary or which isolation model matches the product's safety posture.

options.title: Stage an isolated prototype
options.body: Approve one pinned out-of-process metering backend and one deterministic workload before committing permanent CLI or schema compatibility.

options.title: Accept an embedded runtime
options.body: Approve an in-process runtime such as wazero with explicit resource, preopen, import, timeout, and denial-of-service boundaries.

options.title: Defer the capability
options.body: Keep the documentation as future guidance until a compelling real repository workload and safer runtime contract emerge.

recommendation.title: Stage an isolated prototype
recommendation.body: Approve one pinned out-of-process metering backend and one deterministic workload before committing permanent CLI or schema compatibility.

likelyOwner.reason: They explicitly established this as the canonical product question and articulated the remaining runtime/security decision.
